document.abstract: The Standard committee has continued to function with the type of organization and in accordance with the policies described in the preceding report.<sup>1</sup> This, the final report of the present Committee, includes not only a review of the work of the past two years, but also observations regarding the organization and policies of the Committee in the light of past experience.
